_about: Per-feed sting anchor configuration for podcast_processor/sting_anchor.py. Point the PODLY_STING_CONFIG env var at your copy of this file. Feeds are keyed by Podly feed id. A feed with no entry gets no anchoring. Template paths are resolved relative to this file's directory. Capture a template with scripts/capture_sting_template.py: pick ONE clean, music-only instance of the show's sting (voiceover over the slice destroys the match), 2s is enough for a short sting; a long music bed wants ~7s taken from the transition's onset. The 'offset' is per-show and must be measured: offset = (true ad boundary) - (sting onset) on a known-good break. The two entries below are the measured values from the Operator's two feeds, kept as worked examples.

1._show: Example: a show whose breaks open with a long music bed (motif). START role only -- the show has no return sting.

2._show: Example: a show whose short sting brackets each ad (start + return instances of one asset).
